news.title: Marietta Police arrest mother's boyfriend in connection with 2-year-old's death
news.summary: 23-year-old Darian Keith was booked into the Cobb County Adult Detention Center, where he is facing charges of concealing a death and making false statements.

news.title: Mother’s boyfriend arrested for concealing missing 2-year-old’s death, police say
news.summary: Marietta police said they have arrested the mother’s boyfriend in connection with the 2-year-old reported missing from a Marietta apartment on Friday.

news.title: ‘That crushed me:’ Neighbors shocked by death of 2-year-old reported missing
news.summary: Neighbors are stunned by the death of a 2-year-old boy who was reported missing Friday afternoon from a Marietta apartment complex, and they’re determined to get answers.

news.title: One year later: Emory community remembers DeKalb Officer David Rose killed in CDC attack
news.summary: One year after a deadly attack at the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the Emory community is remembering the DeKalb County police officer who lost his life responding to the violence.

news.title: 2 brothers shot during family fight; father arrested
news.summary: A Clayton County man is facing charges after police say a domestic dispute ended with his two sons being shot Friday night.

news.title: 18-year-old identified as victim in fatal Northwest Atlanta shooting
news.summary: An 18-year-old, identified as Dequaviyon Whatley, died after a dispute in Northwest Atlanta turned violent, according to Atlanta Police.

news.title: Father faces assault charges after two sons shot in Jonesboro
news.summary: A 54-year-old man was arrested Friday night after shooting his two sons during a domestic dispute in Jonesboro.

news.title: Man charged after allegedly placing toddler's body in Marietta woods
news.summary: A man is now facing charges in connection with the death investigation of a 2-year-old found near a Marietta apartment complex after he was reported missing Friday.

news.title: Father arrested after sons injured in Clayton County shooting incident
news.summary: Two men were injured in a Clayton County shooting during a domestic dispute, police say. Suspect was arrested at the scene.

news.title: Memphis Grizzlies player Brandon Clarke's cause of death revealed
news.summary: The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner has determined the cause and manner of death for former Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke, who died at the age of 29 in May.

news.title: Family holds 'no ill will' after woman hit by car driven by young brothers in Oakland
news.summary: A woman who was struck by a car in Oakland driven by two young boys, ages 4 and 6, has begun responding to basic commands, though her family warned she faces a long recovery.

news.title: Child, 6, driving car with 4-year-old brother hits woman walking dog in Oakland
news.summary: A woman is in critical condition after police said a child driving a car struck her while she was walking her dog in a marked crosswalk Thursday morning in Oakland.
